Field.Label: Camera credentials are read from IndigoSecrets.py first (DAHUA_USER and DAHUA_PASS). The fields below are a fallback for installations without that file — anything set there wins over what you type here.
Camera username:
Field.Description: A user with access to the camera's event and config API

Field.Label: Camera password:
Field.Description: Masked in this dialog only — Indigo does not store it securely

Field.Label: Cameras send rapid start/stop pairs as someone moves through frame. The hold keeps a detection switched on for this long after the last event, so one person walking past fires a trigger once rather than a dozen times.
Detection hold (seconds):
Field.Description: Default for all cameras; can be overridden per camera

Field.Label: Every detection is always written in full to this plugin's own log file, at Logs/com.clives.indigoplugin.dahuaevents/plugin.log. The setting below only decides whether it is ALSO echoed to Indigo's shared event log, which every plugin writes to. Two cameras put about fifty lines a day there saying what the devices already show, so it is off to begin with. Warnings and errors always appear in the event log whichever way this is set.
Log detections to the Indigo event log:
Field.Description: Adds a line to the shared event log each time a detection starts and clears
